name: chart-dashboard
description: Sample app for vexproof: a small React dashboard whose production bundle is checked against its npm audit findings

scripts.vex: vexproof --lockfile vex/bom.lockfile.json --bundle vex/bom.bundle.json --modules dist/meta.json --findings vex/audit.json --out vex/vex.cdx.json --openvex vex/vex.openvex.json
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run sbom:lockfile && npm run sbom:bundle && npm run audit && npm run vex
